title: Toni Storm & Mariah May: All About Mariah
summary: The admirer turns against her idol, leading to title exchanges and a Hollywood Ending.

chapters.title: Mariah turns on Toni
chapters.result: May attacks Storm after winning the Owen Hart tournament.
chapters.context: The celebration reveals the challenger as the champion’s betrayer.

chapters.title: Mariah wins at Wembley
chapters.result: May defeats Storm for the Women’s World Championship.
chapters.context: The former admirer takes her idol’s title.

chapters.title: Toni reclaims her championship
chapters.result: Storm defeats May to regain the women’s world title.
chapters.context: The rematch reverses their Wembley result.

chapters.title: The Hollywood Ending
chapters.result: Storm defeats May in their Hollywood Ending match.
chapters.context: The violent rubber match closes this championship trilogy.
